text:
Priya: Quick check — packaging + legal readiness for cross-cloud listing. Need a go/no-go by EOD. AWS & GCP initial setup is blocked by a missing region-tag and SKU mapping.
Tom: Which region-tag exactly? we have eu-west-1 and us-west-2 populated.
Priya: Missing ap-southeast-1 in the manifest (we planned APAC for Q3). Also legal flagged clause in the license about telemetry collection per-region.
Sam: For AWS I can push AMI + CloudFormation today but we still need the marketplace SKU from sales ops. Without SKU we can't publish.
Jess: I can draft the SKU mapping — Andrew from sales-ops owns final approval. Andrew, you around? @Andrew
Andrew: On it, should have SKU map by 3pm. small caveat: enterprise SKUs split by seat vs instance — decision required.
Jess: Proposal: single SKU with metered usage tiers (seat / instance) in the offer metadat — keeps storefront tidy. Thoughts?
Priya: sounds good. Legal: prefer explicit trial-duration per-cloud. For Azure private offers we need trial=14d in the package metadata.
Tom: Quick note on packaging format — use the new artifact layout:
```
manifest.yaml
artifacts/
  images/
  terraform/
```
Include checksum for each artifact.
Sam: terraform snippet for publishing (for ops reference):
```
terraform apply -var='sku=REDWOOD-MKT-001' -var='region=ap-southeast-1'
```
Priya: marketplace-bot added EULA localization task — we need translations for FR/DE/JA. @Jess can we reuse the docs i18n pipeline?
marketplace-bot: New checklist item added: "EULA localization" (priority: medium)
Jess: yes, will kick off i18n run and link strings to the legal doc. ETA: tomorrow morning.
Tom: Ops question — do we want to enable auto-fallback to hosted model when dedicated capacity not available? That affects the offer description.
Priya: Yes, include 'fallback: hosted' in the offering FAQ copy and note cost differential. Legal okay with that? @Andrew / @Legal-team (ping).
Andrew: Legal OK as long as we disclose latency and data residency in the offer page. I'll coordinate with legal to add a short blurb.
Jess: I'll update the storefront copy + hero asset checklist (need a 1200x600 hero + 256x256 icon).
Sam: AMI + terraform ready for AWS once SKU confirmed. GCP image and Azure package need the ap-southeast-1 manifest entry.
Priya: OK — plan: Andrew delivers SKU mapping by 3pm, Jess updates i18n & assets, Sam completes AMI publish, Tom verifies manifest checksums. If all green, we target marketplace staging publish tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
Tom: 👍 will run checksum script after Jess pushes manifest.
Priya: Thanks all — post any blockers here and I'll escalate to PM + Legal if needed.
file_comment: Slack thread covering cross-cloud marketplace packaging, SKU mapping, legal i18n, and go/no-go coordination
